text: Simple meaning: Namaskaram to Shiva in the form of Vishnu, and to Vishnu in the form of Shiva.
This shloka tells us that Vishnu is in Shiva's heart, and Shiva is in Vishnu's heart.
This Karthika masam, bless our family with health, happiness and peace, and joy.
Remove the ignorance in our minds and lead us on the path of dharma.
Forgive any mistakes made in this puja, knowingly or unknowingly, and accept our devotion.”
Finally, take the harathi and bow to Shiva and Keshava.
